name: diego-plugins
description: Diego's filmmaking plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: watch-video
plugins.description: Watch a video, a folder or a whole volume for the edit. /run-volume identifies the media, routes it through the local models and writes a content ledger per folder (shot sentence, light, time of day, what is on screen, KEEP/MARGINAL/CUT with the reason) with no agents and no setup step: missing weights are fetched once, pinned and hash-checked. A measurement always beats the reader's guess. /reflect ranks a pool against a plain-words ask.

plugins.name: premiere-project-file-assembly
plugins.description: Writes Premiere project files from a conversation, a new version each time. Scan data or a media folder becomes bins 00-05, per-card stringouts, INTERVIEWS/BROLL, timecode sync; a small model inside (MiniLM) organizes B-roll by topic, every take of a line, and selects from notes. iPhone footage handled (creation date, slo-mo, vertical, HDR, approximate sync). Writes .prproj with our own prwrite library; xmeml as last resort. Verified by reparse; unopened in Premiere.
